evidence.title: GitHub - ShivaBhattacharjee/KeyZen: A typing test with a keychron keyboard with audiofeedback inspired by Monkeytype

name: KeyZen
summary: Open-source browser typing test with time, words, code, zen, quote and custom modes, a virtual keyboard and key sounds.
description: A clean, browser-based typing speed test: timed and word-count drills, quotes and a zen mode, with results showing WPM, raw speed, accuracy, consistency and a WPM-over-time chart. A virtual keyboard highlights keys as you type on large screens, with per-key sounds via the Web Audio API and optional haptics; settings cover theme, accent color and typography. No accounts or ads; free and open source, inspired by Monkeytype.
contains: six modes: time, words, code, zen, quote, custom
results: WPM, raw speed, accuracy, character breakdown, consistency, WPM chart
virtual keyboard that mirrors expected keys while typing
per-key sounds via Web Audio API, optional haptics
settings: light/dark/system theme, accent color, typography
open source under Apache-2.0, 142 GitHub stars
